reason: A profile-wide DSH bundle plugin that adds a system-prompt instruction requesting Chinese internal reasoning for model sessions and subagents.

summaries.zh: 该插件为指定 DSH profile 的所有会话和子代理添加系统提示词，要求模型使用中文进行内部推理。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a profile-wide system-prompt instruction asking DSH models and subagents to use Chinese for internal reasoning.

capabilities: Registers a global system-prompt section for the installed profile
Instructs models to use Chinese for internal reasoning across sessions
Applies the prompt section to subagents in the profile
